mapper.sql: ISSUANCE_ID, ISSUANCE_NO, PLAN_ID, BOND_NAME, BOND_CODE, BOND_TYPE, ISSUANCE_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, FACE_VALUE, COUPON_RATE, BOND_TERM, TERM_UNIT, PAYMENT_FREQUENCY, UNDERWRITER, TRUSTEE, RATING_AGENCY, CREDIT_RATING, LISTING_EXCHANGE, ISSUANCE_STATUS, ISSUANCE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, INTEREST_PAYMENT_DATE, REDEMPTION_DATE, ACTUAL_ISSUANCE_AMOUNT, ISSUE_COST, UNDERWRITING_FEE, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, DELETE_FLAG, CREATED_BY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_TIME, REMARK
mapper.select: SELECT t.ISSUANCE_ID, t.ISSUANCE_NO, t.PLAN_ID, t.BOND_NAME, t.BOND_CODE, t.BOND_TYPE, t.ISSUANCE_AMOUNT, t.CURRENCY_CODE, t.FACE_VALUE, t.COUPON_RATE, t.BOND_TERM, t.TERM_UNIT, t.PAYMENT_FREQUENCY, t.UNDERWRITER, t.TRUSTEE, t.RATING_AGENCY, t.CREDIT_RATING, t.LISTING_EXCHANGE, t.ISSUANCE_STATUS, t.ISSUANCE_DATE, t.MATURITY_DATE, t.INTEREST_PAYMENT_DATE, t.REDEMPTION_DATE, t.ACTUAL_ISSUANCE_AMOUNT, t.ISSUE_COST, t.UNDERWRITING_FEE, t.COMPANY_ID, t.COMPANY_NAME, t.CREATED_BY, t.CREATED_TIME, t.UPDATED_BY, t.UPDATED_TIME, t.REMARK, D1.ITEM_NAME AS BOND_TYPE_NAME, D2.ITEM_NAME AS CURRENCY_NAME, D3.ITEM_NAME AS TERM_UNIT_NAME, D4.ITEM_NAME AS PAYMENT_FREQUENCY_NAME, D5.ITEM_NAME AS CREDIT_RATING_NAME, D6.ITEM_NAME AS ISSUANCE_STATUS_NAME, S1.STAFF_NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, S2.STAFF_NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME FROM TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE t LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D1 ON t.BOND_TYPE = D1.ITEM_CODE AND D1.DICT_CODE = 'BOND_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D2 ON t.CURRENCY_CODE = D2.ITEM_CODE AND D2.DICT_CODE = 'CURRENCY_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D3 ON t.TERM_UNIT = D3.ITEM_CODE AND D3.DICT_CODE = 'TERM_UNIT' LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D4 ON t.PAYMENT_FREQUENCY = D4.ITEM_CODE AND D4.DICT_CODE = 'PAYMENT_FREQUENCY' LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D5 ON t.CREDIT_RATING = D5.ITEM_CODE AND D5.DICT_CODE = 'CREDIT_RATING' LEFT JOIN TC_DICT_ITEM D6 ON t.ISSUANCE_STATUS = D6.ITEM_CODE AND D6.DICT_CODE = 'ISSUANCE_STATUS' LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF S1 ON t.CREATED_BY = S1.STAFF_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF S2 ON t.UPDATED_BY = S2.STAFF_ID WHERE t.ISSUANCE_ID = #{issuanceId} AND t.DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE SET ISSUANCE_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ISSUANCE_ID = #{issuanceId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0

UPDATE TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE SET DELETE_FLAG = 1, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ISSUANCE_ID IN
#{id}
UPDATE TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE SET ACTUAL_ISSUANCE_AMOUNT = #{actualAmount}, UPDATED_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ISSUANCE_ID = #{issuanceId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_CODE AS value, ITEM_NAME AS label FROM TC_DICT_ITEM WHERE DICT_CODE = 'CREDIT_RATING' AND STATUS = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
SELECT FROM TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ISSUANCE_STATUS = 'ISSUED' AND MATURITY_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + #{days} ORDER BY MATURITY_DATE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(ISSUANCE_AMOUNT) AS total_issuance_amount, SUM(ACTUAL_ISSUANCE_AMOUNT) AS total_actual_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ISSUANCE_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ISSUANCE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approved_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ISSUANCE_STATUS = 'ISSUED' THEN 1 END) AS issued_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ISSUANCE_STATUS = 'MATURITY' THEN 1 END) AS maturity_count FROM TBL_BOND_ISSUANCE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}
